items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: I know where that is. I've been up there near Edgard.

ctx.x: They'd come out of the beer coming out of the air, it was coming out cold.

Were you all both born in the city? Yeah, I was born here. Where were you going? Is that your own village? I know where that is. I've been out there. You know a lot of people. What? What? Uh, near what? Lucy. Oh, near Lucy. Lucy was stuck. Oh, yeah. I know where that is. I've been up there near Edgard.

They think there's a new place. Yeah. The kind of the kids and all that. Yeah. Not the best man for a family? No. Because they had big groceries. And he probably used to be the two one that run all that used to be now. Because he has a big piece on it. Oh. So his father was a freshman. And his mother was a copier. But his mother came from Greece and he didn't have the trench. And so he ran all the amusement out there. What is his name?
